page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 40 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 20 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY processor cores running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.8 GB of RAM per core, and lacks local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates solid processing capabilities, achieving a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec, which drops to 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write bandwidth of 48.09 GB/sec. The system records a Geekbench multi-core score of 12045.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 34691.95, highlighting its capability in handling multi-threaded operations.

With dedicated CPU resources and a balanced memory-to-core ratio, this instance is suited for workloads such as software compilation, database operations, and static web serving. It achieved 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for compute-heavy applications that rely on network-attached storage and do not require hardware acceleration.
